text:
Phase 1 (`requirements_analysis`) is complete. The delta requirements specification has been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261105-feature-extend-arrowhead-size/requirements.md` covering:

- **In scope** (7 numbered, testable items)
- **Out of scope** (7 numbered items reflecting Gate 0 decisions and non-goals)
- **Functional requirements per module** (`FR-1` through `FR-14` across `@excalidraw/element` and `@excalidraw/excalidraw`)
- **Non-functional requirements** (`NFR-1` through `NFR-4`, including snapshot preservation and strict backward compatibility)
- **PII inventory** (none)
- **Role matrix** (editor user and read-only viewer/export)
- **Acceptance criteria** (`AC-1` through `AC-7`, executable via Vitest and the confirmed verification command)
- **Open questions for HITL** (none; all Gate 0 design decisions confirmed)
